translation: The bone bordering the nostrils is called the nasal bridge bone (鼻梁骨); below, to the very end of the nose, is called the nose tip (準頭). In all cases where the two nostrils are injured and sunken, it can be treated; bleeding is of no concern. If the nasal bridge bone is sunken, apply Dang Gui Ointment (當歸膏) to stick it; if the two nostrils are split open by a fall or by a metal blade, apply Feng Kou Yao (封口藥) to the wound, and externally stick Xiao Du Ding Tong San (消毒定痛散) to reduce swelling; if the nose is injured and falls off, use the reattachment method (綴法).
